generation.qualitative: coherent indoor geometry for roughly the first 12 frames, then progressive degradation into smeared texture

scientific_conclusion.evidence: holding conditioning frame, prompt and seed fixed and varying only the action changes the output substantially: still=2.29 and forward=2.72 mean frame difference versus 31.6 and 39.4 for the two turn probes
scientific_conclusion.evidence_against: at 30 deg/frame both turn probes pan the camera the same way (mean horizontal flow -17.5 and -17.8); at 7.5 deg/frame the two differ 30x in magnitude (-10.1 versus -0.33) but still do not produce opposite motion
scientific_conclusion.root_cause_identified: the ObjectNav discrete action space is far outside the camera_pose training distribution in ROTATION but not in translation
scientific_conclusion.quantified: reference camera trajectory shipped with the model averages 0.264 deg/frame of yaw (max 0.349); our option averages 41.25 deg/frame (max 120), a factor of 156. Translation is in range at 0.66x the reference.
scientific_conclusion.ruled_out: a missing action normalizer: no camera_pose normalizer exists and the framework's own inference passes action_normalizer=None, so raw metric actions are the expected input
scientific_conclusion.implication: Cosmos camera_pose forward dynamics cannot currently represent a 30-degree discrete turn. Spreading one turn over enough frames to reach ~0.3 deg/frame would need ~100 frames per primitive turn, i.e. thousands of frames for a 66-action option.
not_claimed: that Cosmos action conditioning is broken in general
any comparison against the Phase 8 predictor
scientific_conclusion.final: Cosmos 3 Nano consumes camera-pose actions, but fails directional action adherence even within its reference rotational regime. The action channel carries translation faithfully and rotation essentially not at all.

arm_a_zero_translation.interpretation: no response at all; commanded yaw is below the model's effective response threshold

arm_b_reference_translation.interpretation: weak magnitude sensitivity, not a sign-respecting rotation; negative and positive yaw both give negative relative flow, and the whole effect is at most 0.33 px

determinism.note: identical action and seed reproduced the video exactly, so the null result is not sampling noise

final_diagnostic.why_decisive: the earlier 30 deg/frame failure could be attributed to operating 156x outside the model's rotational distribution; at 0.25-0.50 deg/frame, bracketing the reference's own 0.264, the model still does not turn in the commanded direction

final_status.phase9_infrastructure: PASS — environment isolation, action interface, manifests, caching, pose derivation and deterministic execution all work and are reusable
final_status.cosmos_as_counterfactual_frontier_predic: FAIL — action-sensitive but not directionally action-faithful
final_status.strongest_conclusion: Under the released Cosmos3-Nano camera-pose interface, action sensitivity does not imply action adherence. Translation affects the generated future, but signed yaw is not represented faithfully, including at the sub-degree rotational scale found in NVIDIA's reference trajectory.
